description: This Java source file defines the AlarmUtil class, which provides utility methods for scheduling, canceling, and retrieving alarms using Android's AlarmManager. It includes methods for setting alarms with specific times and reading/writing Alarm objects to Bundles.

classes.name: AlarmUtil
classes.description: Utility class for scheduling, canceling, and retrieving alarm information using AlarmManager in Android.

methods.name: AlarmUtil
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the AlarmUtil with a Context and obtains an AlarmManager service.

methods.name: scheduleAlarm
methods.description: Schedules an alarm at a specified time using AlarmManager, creating an AlarmClockInfo and a PendingIntent.

methods.name: cancelAlarm
methods.description: Cancels a previously scheduled alarm using the alarm's PendingIntent.

methods.name: getNextAlarmTime
methods.description: Calculates the next alarm time given an hour and minute, adjusting for past times to schedule for the next day.

methods.name: readAlarm
methods.description: Reads an Alarm object from a Bundle of extras.

methods.name: writeAlarm
methods.description: Serializes an Alarm object into a Bundle of extras for storage or passing via Intents.
